coverage.blank_valid_to_semantics: The frozen current source did not provide a removal date. Blank means active in the 2026-08-04 snapshot, subject to independent ETF lifecycle checks.

consumer_requirements: Verify the CSV SHA256 before loading.
Reject duplicate or overlapping symbol effective periods.
Accept only ratio 0.20 and source_id/record_mode values declared by this manifest.
Use 0.10 for uncovered ETFs and record the default-path audit event.
Do not infer membership from a code prefix, fund name, tracking index, or listing date alone at runtime.
Persist this manifest SHA256 and resource_version in each local run metadata file.
